sources.quote: Kepler-1649b is an exoplanet orbiting the red dwarf star Kepler-1649, discovered in 2017.

introduction.text: It is one of 2 planets known around Kepler-1649. Its orbit and size follow Vanderburg et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.

sources.quote: It is similar to Venus, but in the past it was thought to be a candidate for habitability.
